title: A layer of still air
hook: Feather posture can change a layer next to the body.

knows: Birds have body structures and interact with their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: The fluffed feathers create a thicker layer that can trap air near the body. This schematic shows insulation, not an exact temperature or a guarantee that the bird cannot lose heat.

misconception: The observed arrangement has a different effect than the one shown.
objective: A bird fluffs its feathers in cool air. What can the expanded feather layer help hold?
